en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large multi-storey brick school building with many tall windows and decorative stonework, seen from across a fenced street or path. Several small figures stand near the entrance. To the right stands a cylindrical water tower rising above trees. Printed German text appears at the top left identifying the town and the boys' civic school, and a vertical publisher imprint is printed along the right edge.
